default.notes: Consular visitor visa required — BUT holders of a valid visa for the US, Canada, the UK, Japan or a Schengen country are exempt and can enter visa-free for up to 180 days.

groups.notes: Visa-free for tourism and business. The immigration officer sets the length of stay, up to a maximum of 180 days.

Citizens of this country arriving BY AIR can use the free Electronic Authorization (SAE) instead of a consular visa; land/sea arrivals need a visitor visa. Anyone holding a valid US, Canadian, UK, Japanese or Schengen visa is exempt from both.

EC.notes: Mexico reimposed a consular visa requirement for Ecuadorian citizens in 2021; holders of a valid US, Canadian, UK, Japanese or Schengen visa remain exempt.

VE.notes: Mexico reimposed a consular visa requirement for Venezuelan citizens in 2022; holders of a valid US, Canadian, UK, Japanese or Schengen visa remain exempt.

PE.notes: Mexico reintroduced a consular visa requirement for Peruvian citizens in 2024; holders of a valid US, Canadian, UK, Japanese or Schengen visa remain exempt.
